title: US State Privacy Laws Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk exposure across US state laws like CCPA, Virginia CDPA, and Colorado CPA. Get personalized compliance recommendations.
description: Assess your organization's risk exposure under various US state privacy laws including CCPA, Virginia CDPA, Colorado CPA, and emerging regulations. Get tailored compliance recommendations based on your business profile and data practices.

formula: const businessMultipliers = { ecommerce: 1.2, saas: 1.1, healthcare: 1.5, finance: 1.4, marketing: 1.3, other: 1.0 }; const revenueScores = { 'under1m': 10, '1-10m': 20, '10-25m': 35, '25-100m': 50, 'over100m': 70 }; const recordScores = { 'under10k': 5, '10k-100k': 15, '100k-500k': 25, '500k-1m': 35, 'over1m': 50 }; const stateScores = { '1-5': 10, '5-15': 20, '15-30': 30, 'nationwide': 40 }; const dataScores = { basic: 10, extended: 20, sensitive: 35, comprehensive: 50 }; const sharingScores = { none: 0, limited: 10, moderate: 20, extensive: 30 }; const complianceReductions = { none: 0, basic: 0.1, developing: 0.2, mature: 0.4 }; const baseScore = revenueScores[inputs.annualRevenue] + recordScores[inputs.consumerRecords] + stateScores[inputs.operatingStates] + dataScores[inputs.dataTypes] + sharingScores[inputs.thirdPartySharing]; const adjustedScore = Math.min(100, baseScore * businessMultipliers[inputs.businessType] * (1 - complianceReductions[inputs.complianceProgram])); const applicableLawsCount = inputs.operatingStates === 'nationwide' ? 12 : inputs.operatingStates === '15-30' ? 8 : inputs.operatingStates === '5-15' ? 5 : 3; const priorityCount = Math.ceil(adjustedScore / 20); const riskGrade = adjustedScore >= 70 ? 'High Risk' : adjustedScore >= 40 ? 'Medium Risk' : 'Low Risk'; return { overallRisk: Math.round(adjustedScore), riskLevel: riskGrade, applicableLaws: applicableLawsCount, priorityActions: priorityCount };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your privacy risk across major US state laws including CCPA, Virginia CDPA, Colorado CPA, Connecticut CTDPA, and emerging regulations. Risk factors include business size, data volume, geographic scope, data sensitivity, third-party sharing practices, and current compliance maturity. The scoring considers revenue thresholds, consumer record counts, and regulatory requirements specific to each state law.
tips: Use Incognito Browser to research state privacy laws without tracking your compliance research activities
Document all personal data collection and processing activities before conducting privacy impact assessments
Implement privacy by design principles early to reduce future compliance costs and risks
Regularly review and update privacy policies to reflect changing state law requirements
Consider appointing a dedicated privacy officer if your risk score is above 60
Establish data minimization practices to reduce your overall privacy risk exposure
Monitor emerging state privacy legislation as new laws are frequently proposed

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Your business has minimal exposure to state privacy law requirements. Focus on basic privacy policy updates and data inventory documentation.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Your business faces moderate compliance obligations. Prioritize consumer rights infrastructure and data processing agreements with vendors.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Your business has significant exposure to multiple state privacy laws. Immediate action needed on compliance program development and risk mitigation.
